output.subject: A document parsing API your readers building AP pipelines will actually want to know about
output.pitch:
Data Engineering Weekly's audience includes engineers building document ingestion and AP automation workflows — exactly the people who hit a wall when generic OCR breaks on invoice layout variety.

DocParse is a layout-aware document parsing API that extracts line items, totals, tax fields, and vendor data from invoices, receipts, and purchase orders into structured JSON. It delivers 99.2% field-level accuracy on a published 5,000-invoice benchmark, with p95 latency of 1.8 seconds per page tracked on a public metrics page. Per-field confidence scores and a configurable human-in-the-loop fallback give engineering teams a production-grade accuracy SLA without weeks of model tuning per document type.

For readers who have evaluated AWS Textract or Google Document AI and found the tuning overhead prohibitive, this is a direct alternative with published methodology rather than vendor claims.

Pricing starts at $0.01 per page with 500 free pages. SOC 2 Type I report is available under NDA.
